prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Pet Art Style", "Choose your preferred visual aesthetic before uploading reference photos.", "Art Style Selection"]
1: ["Upload Pet Photos for AI Generation", "Upload clear reference photos to ensure accurate desktop pet creation.", "Upload Photos", "Clear face view, good lighting, no heavy filters"]
2: ["Test & Calibrate Desktop Pet Controls", "Verify pet visibility on your desktop screen and test shortcut controls before completing setup.", "Test Shortcut Controls"]
3: ["Your Companion is Waking Up!", "Your custom pet is being generated and prepared for your desktop environment."]
4: ["You can add custom pets or pick preset pets anytime later from app settings."]
5: ["Use your original sign-in method to restore and sync existing desktop pets."]
6: ["Sign In to Enable Cloud Pet Backups", "Creating an account saves your pet progress so your desktop companion is never lost."]
7: ["Choose & Name Your New Companion", "Select your companion mascot and give them a name to personalize their desktop behavior.", "Enter Pet Name"]
8: ["Create Your Custom AI Companion", "Clear front-facing photos work best. Generation takes about 1-2 minutes to prepare your companion."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet to interact or change settings. Press Ctrl+Alt+P anytime to show or hide them."]
